name: LastFM Album Metadata (22k Entries)
description: Album-level metadata retrieved from Last.fm using the Last.fm API. The API was queried using album names from the MusicBrainz dataset as query strings. The original retrieval contains over 85,000 entities. A reduced version contains around 22,000 entries and provides album name and artist, as well as tracklists including track title, duration, and position on the album. Additional fields present in the CSV include the Last.fm URL for the album and popularity indicators returned by the API (listeners and playcount).

variableMeasured.name: artist
variableMeasured.description: Artist name associated with the album entry, as stored in the dataset.

variableMeasured.name: name
variableMeasured.description: Album name (title) as stored in the dataset (used as the query string to the Last.fm API).

variableMeasured.name: url
variableMeasured.description: Last.fm URL for the album entry.

variableMeasured.name: id
variableMeasured.description: Internal dataset identifier for the LastFM album record (e.g., 'lastFM_24').

variableMeasured.name: listeners
variableMeasured.description: Listener count returned by the Last.fm API for the album entry.

variableMeasured.name: playcount
variableMeasured.description: Play count returned by the Last.fm API for the album entry.

variableMeasured.name: tracks_track_name
variableMeasured.description: Track titles for the album entry, stored as a string representation of a list in the CSV (e.g., "['Track A', 'Track B']").

variableMeasured.name: tracks_track_rank
variableMeasured.description: Track positions/ranks corresponding to tracks_track_name, stored as a string representation of a list in the CSV.

variableMeasured.name: tracks_track_duration
variableMeasured.description: Track durations corresponding to tracks_track_name, stored as a string representation of a list in the CSV. Example entries indicate values in seconds.

variableMeasured.name: tracks_track_artist
variableMeasured.description: Track artist names corresponding to tracks_track_name, stored as a string representation of a list in the CSV.
